$comment: Entry schema for contributes.searchProviders (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_search_providers.go and search_provider_invoke.go. prefix must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$, must not be a reserved word or URL scheme ({{lists.reservedPrefixes}}) and must be unique within the plugin; when two plugins claim the same prefix the lexicographically smallest plugin id wins. action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'. While the user types '<prefix>:' in the command palette the host calls it through plugin_host_search with {provider, query, locale} (query <= {{limits.queryMaxRunes}} characters, payload <= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, {{limits.debounceMs}} ms debounce, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms) and expects {"items": [{id, title, detail?, target}]} (<= {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes, first {{limits.itemsMax}} items kept, invalid items dropped). target is {type: 'view', view, args?} (one of this plugin's views, <= {{limits.argsMaxProperties}} scalar args), {type: 'command', command, args?} (one of this plugin's action commands with effective risk 'read'; args only when the command declares inputSchema and valid against it) or {type: 'url', url} (absolute http(s) URL, opened in the system browser only when the user picks the item).
description: Command palette search providers: answer queries typed after a prefix (for example 'jira:') through one of this plugin's read actions.

prefix.description: Typed before ':' in the command palette to query this provider.

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'.

minQueryLength.description: Characters needed after the prefix before the provider is called; defaults to 1.
